paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption_used: Coverage as a function of the number of completions (k) for Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. All four models exhibit monotonically increasing coverage with additional completions on a logarithmic x-axis from 2^0 to 2^8. The 3B models begin at approximately 0.42 coverage and reach roughly 0.92 at k=256, while the 1B variants start near 0.22 and plateau at approximately 0.72 by k=128 with minimal further gains. Notably, fine-tuning provides a consistent advantage of approximately 5 percentage points for the 1B model throughout the scaling curve, whereas the 3B base and fine-tuned variants remain largely indistinguishable.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates coverage as a function of the number of completions (*k*) for four model variants: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" on a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.2 to 0.9. Four lines are shown. The Llama-3B line is depicted in dark blue with solid lines and filled circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.42 at k=1 and increases monotonically, reaching roughly 0.70 near k=8, approximately 0.82 near k=32, and approximately 0.92 at k=256. The Llama-3B + FT line is shown in green with a dashed line and filled square markers; it follows a very similar trajectory to the Llama-3B line, starting at approximately 0.43 at k=1 and reaching approximately 0.91 at k=256, with the two lines remaining closely overlapping throughout. The Llama-1B line is depicted in light blue/lavender with a solid line and open circle markers; it begins at approximately 0.22 at k=1, rises to roughly 0.50 near k=8, reaches approximately 0.65 near k=32, and plateaus around 0.72 by k=128, with minimal change to k=256. The Llama-1B + FT line is shown in light green with a solid line and open triangle markers; it starts at approximately 0.27 at k=1 and follows a similar shape to the Llama-1B line but shifted upward, reaching approximately 0.55 near k=8, about 0.70 near k=32, and approximately 0.78 at k=256. All four lines exhibit monotonically increasing coverage across the range of completions.
